svg.title: Android QR scanner mockups: scanning, a code that is not a UMSH code, a node code opening the import preview over Peers, and a channel code opening the join preview over Conversations

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: opens the one scanner, full screen above the shell. The

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: camera is asked for the first time it opens

svg.text: (Permissions). Close returns.

svg.text: read: the frame says what to do.

svg.text: reported in a pill and the scanner keeps running; the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: pill goes away when the code leaves the frame.
